name: CIEM T-Shirt
description:
CIEM T-shirt (Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management)

Materials:
• 60% Wiz Code fabric – Blocks excessive permissions before they turn your cloud into an open buffet for hackers.
• 40% Shifted Left-er threading – Dynamically adjusts to manage who can access what—because least privilege should start way before production panic mode.

Benefits:
• Stops identity chaos – Like Wiz CIEM, this shirt ensures only the right people (or non-humans) have access—because “admin for everyone” is not a security strategy.
• Govern like a pro – Continuous permission management, even when teams forget who actually needs access.

Complete the look: Perfect for your next “security review” meeting—where serious elephants discuss IAM policies while cats jump around the table in full chaos mode.

name: CDR T-Shirt
description:
CDR T-shirt (Cloud Detection and Response)

Materials:
• 30% Defend™ fabric – Detects multi-layer threats, even when your SOC team is over it.
• 70% Sensor threads – Embedded with real-time runtime protection that doesn’t slow you down.

Benefits:
• Stay ahead of attacks – Like Wiz Defend, this shirt helps teams respond before a breach becomes the incident of the quarter.
• Detects threats across layers – Identity, data, network—yep, all of it.
• SOC & chicken-friendly speed – Speeds up investigations so you can stop refreshing that incident ticket.

Complete the look: Wear it to stay protected while a stressed-out office chicken avoids eye contact.

name: DSPM T-Shirt
description:

Materials:

• 30% Cloudy silk™ weave – Smooths out compliance pains so you don’t wake up in a GDPR nightmare.

Benefits:
• Finds sensitive data before hackers or ducks do – Just like Wiz DSPM, this shirt knows where your data is hiding.
• Compliance made... less painful – Automates security checks so your auditors aren’t sending daily Slack messages.

Complete the look: Top it off with ducks in office uniforms frantically sorting data breaches. Because why should only humans have data breaches when ducks can do it with flair?

name: CWPP T-Shirt
description:

• 50% Runtime sensor™ fiber – Continuously monitors workloads like a paranoid SOC analyst.

Benefits:
• Zero trust, zero problem corgi style – Like Wiz Defend, this shirt reduces attack surfaces across VMs, containers, and serverless workloads.

• Shift-left approved – Finds issues before production, because fixing them later is painful.

Complete the look: Best paired with a herd of corgis happily ignoring critical threats "Short legs = can't reach problem."

name: AI-SPM T-Shirt
description:

name: CSPM T-Shirt
description:
CSPM T-shirt (Cloud Security Posture Management)

Materials:

• 50% Elastic thread – Stretches to meet over 1,400 compliance frameworks without breaking—unlike your patience during an audit.

Benefits:
• Full coverage, no surprises – Like Wiz Cloud CSPM, this shirt ensures no cloud resource goes unnoticed (or unprotected).

Complete the look: Wear it with confidence while two office chameleons argue if the "distracted boyfriend" meme is about multi-cloud or an exposed S3 bucket—right as the printer crashes again.
